content_sections.heading: OUAT Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the OUAT Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: OUAT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 64 years. Age will be calculated as on 31 October 2026. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: OUAT Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: The salary for the Guest Faculty post will be Rs. 1,200/- per class to a maximum of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for OUAT Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the OUAT Guest Faculty posts is scheduled to be held on 03 October 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions at OUAT?
faq.answer: Odisha University of Agriculture and Technology (OUAT) has announced a total of 6 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. Generally, candidates need a BFSc and MFSc degree with at least 55% marks in relevant aquaculture-related subjects, or a Master's degree in English with 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Guest Faculty positions at OUAT?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty posts is 64 years. The age will be calculated as of 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty positions at OUAT?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty positions is structured as Rs. 1,200/- per class, with a maximum monthly salary capped at Rs. 60,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Guest Faculty positions at OUAT?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required original documents and self-attested copies on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for OUAT Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 500. This fee needs to be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the OUAT office. The exact address and reporting time will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates. However, it is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific provisions.
